blocks_element.text: The 3 primary signs of aging in your hands, and how to treat them.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Our hands are our most exposed body pa…
blocks_element.text: Our hands are our most exposed body part other than our faces. Brown spots, crepey texture, dry skin and fine lines show are appearing prematurely. Our hands deserve a skincare routine.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · The skin on our hands is thin and flex…
blocks_element.text: The skin on our hands is thin and flexible and as we age and lose collagen, our hands develop a crepey texture and appearance. How to prevent this: daily moisturizing, active ingredients like Bakuchiol, Niacinamide and Hyaluronic Acid plump the skin, restore elasticity and improve tone and texture.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Constant exposure to UV (from the sun …
blocks_element.text: Constant exposure to UV (from the sun or gel lamps) cause dark spots to appear on the tops of our hands. How to prevent this: SPF is essential to protect your hands, but ingredients like gallic acid and vitamin C work to fade the spots and brighten skin if they have already appeared.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Years of manicures can take a toll on …
blocks_element.text: Years of manicures can take a toll on our nails. Brittle, dehydrated, thin nails can make your hands look older than they are. How to prevent this: treat your nails to active ingredients like biotin and keratin to strengthen, hydrate and repair nails in between manicures. This will also keep your cuticles healthy and soft.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · I have spoken to so many people who fe…
blocks_element.text: I have spoken to so many people who feel self conscious about their hands. Complaints of eczema, chronic dryness, cracked skin, thin and brittle nails, age spots, wrinkles, and crepey skin texture. And it's not surprising - our hands are our second most exposed body part, and we often neglect them from our body care routines. It was hearing these stories that inspired me to create a simple daily skincare routine for hands. By using skincare grade ingredients on your hands every day, you can prevent the premature signs of aging, and enjoy soft, hydrated, youthful and glowing hands.
